weatherForecast.comment: On Friday it will be sunny. The wind will be light.

avalancheActivity.highlights: New snow and wind slabs at higher altitudes.
avalancheActivity.comment: The new snow and wind slabs of the last two days can be released in isolated cases in all aspects and generally at higher altitudes. The avalanche prone locations are to be found in particular adjacent to ridgelines and in gullies and bowls in all aspects and in shady places that are protected from the wind. Very steep sunny slopes intermediate and high altitudes: As a consequence of solar radiation snow slides are possible as the day progresses.

snowpackStructure.comment: At mid and high altitudes there are 5 to 20 cm of snow, and even more in some localities. The northwesterly wind has transported the new snow. As a consequence of falling temperatures the snowpack will become faceted during the course of the night and therefore lose strength.

travelAdvisory.highlights: The Avalanche Warning Service currently has only a small amount of information, so that the avalanche danger should be investigated especially thoroughly in the relevant locality.

tendency.highlights: The danger of moist snow slides will increase a little during the day. The danger of dry avalanches will decrease gradually.
